content: Exact/correct score market from Poisson (or Dixon-Coles adjusted) joint score matrix: P(i-j)=Pois(i;lambda)*Pois(j;mu) (times tau for 0-0,1-0,0-1,1-1), displayed as heatmap over 0-0..5-5 (or 0-6) with tail aggregated to other; fair odds=1/p per scoreline; many scorelines means per-score probabilities are small and long-tailed - books offer limited score sets (10-14 common lines), overround spread across subset differs from model full matrix, so value gates need subset normalization; settlement straightforward from final score; Dixon-Coles materially improves draw/low-score calibration for this market.
